name: Cryptographic Key Management Assessment
description: Assessment of cryptographic key lifecycle management including key generation, storage, distribution, rotation, revocation, and destruction. Covers HSM integration, key wrapping, key derivation functions (HKDF, KDF1/2), secrets management systems, and compliance with NIST SP 800-57 key management guidance. Focuses on key lifecycle and policy; protection of keys in hardware storage against physical and logical extraction belongs to HWSEC-CRYPTO-KEY.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to key management assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands key lifecycle phases and why key management matters
evidence: Can describe the key lifecycle: generation, distribution, storage, rotation, revocation, destruction
Understands why hardcoded keys and insecure key storage are dangerous
Can explain the purpose of HSMs and key management systems

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Identifies key management practices and basic weaknesses under supervision
evidence: Detects hardcoded cryptographic keys in source code and configuration files
Reviews key storage mechanisms (file system, environment variables, vaults) under guidance
Documents key management findings following lab templates

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses key management practices across systems
evidence: Evaluates key generation quality (entropy sources, RNG seeding)
Assesses key storage solutions (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) for configuration security
Reviews key derivation function usage (HKDF, PBKDF2) for correctness
Produces findings referencing NIST SP 800-57 or PCI DSS key management requirements

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex key management assessments; evaluates key management architecture
evidence: Assesses HSM integration and key ceremony procedures
Evaluates key wrapping and key escrow implementations
Reviews key management across distributed systems and microservice architectures
Mentors junior staff on key management assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines key management assessment methodology; recognised authority on key lifecycle security
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's key management assessment methodology
Published research on key management vulnerabilities or best practices
Provides expert guidance on key management architecture design
Trains teams on key lifecycle management, HSM integration, and compliance requirements

assessment_methods.description: Audit key management practices across an application stack: evaluate generation, storage, rotation, and destruction processes
Given an application with multiple key management weaknesses, design a remediation plan including migration to a secrets management system
